GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 400.703 (5 Nov 46) ESS/FT
(SCAPIN-1313)
APO 500
5 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Sale to Imperial Japanese Government, as Surplus, of Approved Civilian Type Military Supplies of United States Government.
1. Reference is made to paragraph 1 of letter, Central Liaison Office, Tokyo, C. L. O. No. 2321 (ET), dated 14 May 1946, subject, “Purchase of Trucks and Trailers of U. S. Army Surplus in Kobe.”
2. The Imperial Japanese Governmant is hereby authorized to purchase from the Foreign Liquidation Commission of the United States, vehicles and such other civilian type military supplies as may be specifically approved. Purchase will be effected by contractural agreement negotiated through and with the specific permission of General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
3. Direct communication is hereby authorized between interested staff sections of General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and designated agencies of the Imperial Japanese Government to implement provisions of this memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.

MEMO FOR RECORD: (SCAPIN - 1313)
PAM/CVM/AML/jmb
4 November 1946
1. This directive authorizes the Imperial Japanese Government to sign a letter of agreement with the Foreign Liquidation Commission for M purchase of surplus vehicles and other civilian type military supplies approved by SCAP.
2. The directive was an integral part of a staff study - "Disposal of Durplus and Excess Military Surplus in Japan to Japanese Government, dated 30 July 1946, and as such was approved by the Chief of Staff.
3. This problem as it relates to Korea has been considered.
4. No concurrences required.
Refer any questions to Mr. W.R. Mayers, Tel 2-2341
P. A. M.
